items.title: Nvidia (NVDA) Forms Alliance To Build A Power Flexible AI Data Center
items.summary: NVIDIA (NasdaqGS:NVDA), Google, and Emerald AI have created the AI Energy Management Alliance to coordinate electricity use in AI data centers.
